desktop.notes:
• Updates now come from a private update server and need an access key that comes with your copy (Windows: the access.key file next to Cullect.exe, already in the zip you were sent; phone: paste it once in Settings). Nothing else changes.
• If a key is missing or switched off, Settings -> Updates says so and lets you paste a new one.
